name: Passport Checklist
description: A passport checklist for applying for or renewing a passport, covering requirements, photos, forms, fees, and timing.

items.text: Confirm whether you can renew or must reapply
Read your country's official passport requirements
Check the processing time against your travel dates
Note whether you must apply in person or by mail
Verify all rules with the official authority
items.note: Requirements and fees vary and change, so check officially

items.text: Proof of citizenship as specified
Proof of identity, such as a current ID
Your previous passport if renewing
Supporting documents for any name change
Documents required for a child's application
Take photos meeting the exact specifications
Check size, background, and lighting rules
Follow rules on glasses, head coverings, and expression
Use an approved photo service if unsure
Bring spare copies in case one is rejected
Download or collect the correct application form
Fill in every field accurately and legibly
Arrange any required signatures or witnesses
Double-check names, dates, and numbers
Review the form against the official checklist
Confirm the current fees and accepted payment methods
Decide on standard or expedited processing
Book an appointment if required
Submit by mail or in person as instructed
Keep your receipt and tracking details
Verify all rules before relying on this list
items.note: Requirements, eligibility, fees, and timelines vary by country and change; always apply through your official passport authority

faq.q: What documents do I need to apply for a passport?
faq.a: Usually proof of identity, proof of citizenship, completed forms, photos, and fees. The exact list depends on your country and whether it is a first application or a renewal, so confirm with your official passport authority.

faq.q: How long does it take to get a passport?
faq.a: Processing times vary widely by country and season and can stretch during busy periods. Apply well before any planned travel, and check current timelines and any expedited options on the official passport site.

faq.q: What are the rules for passport photos?
faq.a: Photo rules are strict and cover size, background, expression, and recency. They vary by country, so follow your passport authority's exact specifications, or use an approved photo service to avoid a rejected application.

faq.q: Can I renew my passport instead of reapplying?
faq.a: Many people qualify to renew rather than reapply, which is often simpler. Eligibility depends on your current passport's status and your country's rules, so check the official guidance for renewal conditions.
